about.title: An academic profile shaped by analytical and managerial thinking.
paragraphs: I completed the Bachelor’s Programme in Industrial Management at New Uzbekistan University, taught exclusively in English. My academic work spans finance, accounting, economics, analytics, operations and management.

I am preparing for graduate study in fields that connect management with finance, analytics, sustainability and digital transformation, while building on practical experience in business analysis and project delivery.

experience.description: MAGMASTORE is a B2B e-commerce platform in Uzbekistan connecting business buyers with suppliers. As Project Manager, I coordinate requirements, workflows and cross-functional delivery.
Worked with business requirements, process analysis, workflow definition and reporting to support clearer decisions and more structured delivery.
Gained international work experience in a fast-paced operational environment while living and working independently in Nuremberg, Germany.

projects.title: ERP Post-Implementation in Uzbek Manufacturing

projects.title: Real-Time Capacity Monitoring for Manufacturing
projects.description: University team project designing an Industry 4.0 concept that connects customer orders with live production-capacity data so Sales and Operations can make decisions from the same information.

recommendations.title: Academic Recommendation — Prof. Dr. Dr. Paul P. Momtaz
recommendations.recommender: Prof. Dr. Dr. Paul P. Momtaz
recommendations.organization: TUM School of Management · Technical University of Munich
recommendations.relationship: Guest lecturer at New Uzbekistan University
recommendations.summary: Following a guest lecture at New Uzbekistan University, Prof. Momtaz highlighted my academic engagement, quality of class contributions, maturity, reliability and ability to work across diverse backgrounds, and gave me an unreserved recommendation.

details.heading: Academic engagement
details.body: Prof. Momtaz first encountered my work during a guest lecture at New Uzbekistan University in March 2025. He notes that I was among the most active participants and stood out for the quality of my contributions to class discussions.

details.heading: Character & collaboration
details.body: His letter describes me as intellectually strong, modest, mature and reliable, noting calmness, decency and mutual respect in working with others.

details.heading: Communication & social skills
details.body: He highlights my ability to communicate with and adapt to people from different backgrounds, describing my networking and social skills positively alongside my extracurricular activities.

details.heading: Learning & ambition
details.body: He notes that I am eager to learn and equally willing to share experience with other strong students, with an ambition to contribute to management and economics.

details.heading: Overall assessment
details.body: Drawing on his teaching experience across TUM, Goethe University Frankfurt and UCLA, including MBA and Executive MBA students, Prof. Momtaz places me at the very top of New Uzbekistan University’s graduating cohort and recommends me without reservation.
